quizzes.question_en: I have a big smart ........... I put it in my living room.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: الجملة تصف جهازًا ذكيًا كبيرًا يُوضع عادة في غرفة المعيشة، وهذا يصف التلفاز أكثر من الأثاث أو التكييف.
quizzes.why_answer_ar: TV يتناسب مع وصف smart وغرفة المعيشة كمكان للترفيه.
quizzes.grammar_rule_ar: استخدم أسماء الأشياء المنزلية حسب السياق: أجهزة مقابل أثاث.
quizzes.vocabulary: TV = تلفاز | smart = ذكي | living room = غرفة المعيشة
quizzes.common_mistake_ar: الخلط بين sofa (أريكة) وبين جهاز إلكتروني.
quizzes.example_sentence_en: We bought a big smart TV for the living room.

quizzes.question_en: My bag went missing a few months ago. Yesterday, I found it ........... the bedroom cabinet when I was deep-cleaning.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: وجدت الحقيبة خلف خزانة غرفة النوم؛ behind تدل على موضع الإخفاء أو الوضع الخلفي.
quizzes.why_answer_ar: السياق يفيد أن المكان غير ظاهر مباشرة أثناء التنظيف العميق.
quizzes.grammar_rule_ar: حروف الجر للمكان: behind = خلف، on = على، opposite = مقابل.
quizzes.vocabulary: bedroom = غرفة نوم | cabinet = خزانة | deep-cleaning = تنظيف عميق
quizzes.common_mistake_ar: استخدام on فقط لأي سطح دون التفكير في إخفاء الشيء.
quizzes.example_sentence_en: The keys fell behind the cabinet.

quizzes.question_en: Ahmad Saleh works in a hospital. His ........... is a doctor.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: الطبيب يصف المهنة وليس اسم العائلة ولا صلة القرابة.
quizzes.why_answer_ar: occupation تعني المهنة وهي ما يحتاجه السؤال.
quizzes.grammar_rule_ar: occupation / job / profession للحديث عن العمل.
quizzes.vocabulary: hospital = مستشفى | occupation = مهنة | doctor = طبيب
quizzes.example_sentence_en: Her occupation is nursing.

quizzes.question_en: I like pizza ........... hamburgers, but I don't like pasta.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: نربط بين نوعين من الطعام المتشابهين في الإعجاب باستخدام and قبل but.
quizzes.why_answer_ar: الجملة الثانية تبدأ بـ but، والأولى تذكر إعجابًا بأكثر من شيء مرتبط.
quizzes.grammar_rule_ar: and لجمع عناصر متوافقة؛ but لمعارضة لاحقة.
quizzes.vocabulary: pizza = بيتزا | hamburgers = همبرغر | pasta = معكرونة
quizzes.common_mistake_ar: استخدام or عندما لا يوجد اختيار بل إعجاب بكليهما.
quizzes.example_sentence_en: I like tea and coffee, but I don't like soda.

quizzes.question_en: I ........... 3 languages: Arabic, English and Turkish.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: نقول speak مع اللغات عند الحديث عن القدرة على التحدث بها.
quizzes.why_answer_ar: التركيب speak + languages ثابت في الإنجليزية.
quizzes.grammar_rule_ar: speak a language / talk to someone — فرق شائع.
quizzes.common_mistake_ar: استخدام talk بدون to بشكل خاطئ مع اللغات.
quizzes.example_sentence_en: She speaks French fluently.

quizzes.question_en: Jeddah is famous for ........... beautiful beaches.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: its (بدون فتحة) ضمير ملكية لشيء أو مكان؛ هنا لجدة.
quizzes.why_answer_ar: it's = it is / it has وليست ضمير ملكية.
quizzes.grammar_rule_ar: its مقابل it's: ملكية مقابل اختصار.
quizzes.vocabulary: famous for = مشهور بـ | beaches = شواطئ
quizzes.common_mistake_ar: كتابة it's بدل its قبل اسم.
quizzes.example_sentence_en: The city is known for its history.

quizzes.question_en: Our car is ........... It was made in Germany.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: صنع في ألمانيا فيعني أن السيارة ألمانية الجنسية/النوع.
quizzes.why_answer_ar: German صفة تتوافق مع made in Germany.
quizzes.grammar_rule_ar: صفات الجنسية بأحرف كبيرة عند استخدامها كصفة.
quizzes.common_mistake_ar: اختيار صفة لا تطابق بلد الصنع.
quizzes.example_sentence_en: This is a German engineering brand.

quizzes.question_en: There ........... many books on my desk.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: many books جمع، فيتطلب there are.
quizzes.grammar_rule_ar: There is/are حسب المذكور بعدها مباشرة.
quizzes.example_sentence_en: There are two cups on the table.

quizzes.question_en: I have 15 ........... in my fishtank.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: fish غالبًا نفس الشكل للمفرد والجمع عند عدّ الأسماك.
quizzes.why_answer_ar: 15 تدل على جمع، والشكل المعياري fish.
quizzes.grammar_rule_ar: fish — جمع غير منتظم شائع؛ fishes نادر لأنواع مختلفة.
quizzes.example_sentence_en: We saw many fish in the lake.

quizzes.question_en: A: Is Salim your cousin? B: No, he is my ........... My mom remarried after my dad passed away.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: إعادة الزواج تفسر أخًا من أحد الأبوين فقط: half-brother.
quizzes.vocabulary: remarried = تزوجت مجددًا | passed away = توفي
quizzes.common_mistake_ar: brother العام دون تمييز الأخ غير الأشقاء بالكامل.
quizzes.example_sentence_en: She has a half-sister on her father's side.

quizzes.question_en: A: Where ........... they from? B: They are from Egypt.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: they جمع، مع are في الأسئلة والإجابات.
quizzes.why_answer_ar: Where are they from? تركيب ثابت.
quizzes.grammar_rule_ar: أدوات be مع الضمائر: they are.
quizzes.example_sentence_en: Where are you from?

quizzes.question_en: These are ........... shoes. Look, they're not in your size.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: المتحدث يشير لحذائه هو وليس للمخاطب.
quizzes.why_answer_ar: الجملة الثانية تفند أنها حذاء المخاطب.
quizzes.common_mistake_ar: your عندما يكون الكلام موجهًا لشخص لكن المعنى يقتضي المتحدث.
quizzes.example_sentence_en: These are my gloves, not yours.

quizzes.question_en: There is ........... in my driveway.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: There is مع مفرد معدود a car صحيح نحويًا.
quizzes.why_answer_ar: many car خطأ؛ 2 cars يتطلب there are.
quizzes.grammar_rule_ar: there is + مفرد / there are + جمع.
quizzes.example_sentence_en: There is a problem with the engine.

quizzes.question_en: I live in Jeddah, ........... I am from Dammam.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: تباين بين مكان السكن والأصل يبرره but.
quizzes.vocabulary: live in = أسكن في | from = من (أصل)
quizzes.example_sentence_en: She is young, but she is very wise.

quizzes.question_en: I can't find the ........... I need to light the candles on the cake.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: إشعال الشموع يحتاج ولاعة lighter.
quizzes.common_mistake_ar: اختيار أدوات لا علاقة لها بالنار.
quizzes.example_sentence_en: Do you have a lighter or matches?

quizzes.question_en: I ........... a journalist. I am a photographer.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: نفي I am بصيغة I'm not.
quizzes.grammar_rule_ar: أدوات be مع الضمائر: I'm not / you aren't.
quizzes.example_sentence_en: I'm not ready yet.

quizzes.question_en: My car is not ........... It was made in 2023.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: صنع حديثًا فيعني ليست قديمة؛ old منطقي بعد النفي.
quizzes.grammar_rule_ar: صفات وصف حالة الشيء مع الزمن.
quizzes.common_mistake_ar: new بعد النفي رغم أن الجملة تؤكد الحداثة.
quizzes.example_sentence_en: The building is not old; it opened last year.

quizzes.question_en: I can't reach ........... books. They are up on that shelf.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: كتب بعيدة على الرف تشير إليها those.
quizzes.example_sentence_en: Those boxes are too high for me.

quizzes.question_en: I bought some ........... from the supermarket yesterday.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: بعض البطاطس جمع صحيح potatoes.
quizzes.example_sentence_en: We need three potatoes for the soup.

quizzes.question_en: A: Are you from Boston? B: No, ........... I'm from Chicago.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: نفي are you بـ No, I'm not.
quizzes.why_answer_ar: Imn't غير موجود في الإنجليزية المعيارية.
quizzes.grammar_rule_ar: اختصار am not → I'm not في الكلام.
quizzes.common_mistake_ar: استخدام am not وحدها دون ضمير في الرد القصير.
quizzes.example_sentence_en: A: Are you tired? B: No, I'm not.

quizzes.question_en: There isn't ........... milk in the fridge.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: في النفي مع اسم غير معدود نستخدم any أكثر شيوعًا من some.
quizzes.why_answer_ar: isn't + any يوافق المعنى: لا يوجد حليب.
quizzes.grammar_rule_ar: some في الإثبات؛ any غالبًا في النفي والأسئلة.
quizzes.common_mistake_ar: استخدام some بعد isn't في نفي عام بسيط عن الكمية.
quizzes.example_sentence_en: There isn't any sugar left.

quizzes.question_en: I bought ........... apple for breakfast.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: apple تبدأ بصوت علة فنستخدم an وليس a.
quizzes.why_answer_ar: قاعدة a/an حسب الصوت الأول وليس الحرف فقط.
quizzes.grammar_rule_ar: a قبل صوت ساكن، an قبل صوت علة.
quizzes.example_sentence_en: I ate an orange this morning.

quizzes.question_en: We have ........... friends in London.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: friends جمع معدود فيستخدم many.
quizzes.why_answer_ar: much للغير معدود؛ many للجمع المعدود.
quizzes.example_sentence_en: There are many students here.

quizzes.question_en: How ........... sugar do you take in your coffee?
quizzes.arabic_explanation: sugar غير معدود فنسأل How much.
quizzes.why_answer_ar: How many للمعدود؛ How much للكميات.
quizzes.example_sentence_en: How much water do you need?

quizzes.question_en: I need some ........... to make a sandwich.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: الساندويتش يحتاج خبز bread.
quizzes.grammar_rule_ar: some + اسم قابل للعدد أو غير معدود حسب المعنى.
quizzes.common_mistake_ar: اختيار أشياء لا تُستخدم عادة في الساندويتش.
quizzes.example_sentence_en: Buy some bread from the bakery.

quizzes.question_en: There are ........... students in the classroom today.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: students جمع معدود → many.
quizzes.example_sentence_en: There are many chairs in the room.

quizzes.question_en: We don't have ........... rice left.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: في النفي مع rice غير معدود نستخدم any.
quizzes.why_answer_ar: don't have any شائع في الكلام اليومي.
quizzes.grammar_rule_ar: any في النفي؛ some في الإثبات غالبًا.
quizzes.common_mistake_ar: some بعد don't have عن غير معدود أحيانًا يُقبل في عروض لكن any الأدق هنا.
quizzes.example_sentence_en: We don't have any time.

quizzes.question_en: How many ........... do we have?
quizzes.arabic_explanation: How many يتبعه جمع معدود: bottles.
quizzes.example_sentence_en: How many bottles are there?

quizzes.question_en: She needs a ........... of milk.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: كمية حليب سائلة قد تُقاس بكأس glass في هذا السياق التعليمي.
quizzes.why_answer_ar: وحدات القياس: a glass of milk.
quizzes.example_sentence_en: Pour a glass of milk, please.

quizzes.question_en: I bought two ........... of milk.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: زجاجتان من الحليب bottles of milk.
quizzes.grammar_rule_ar: قطع الحليب السائل بالزجاجة شائع في التعبير.
quizzes.example_sentence_en: Two bottles of water, please.

quizzes.question_en: He ate a ........... of chocolate after lunch.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: شوكولاتة على شكل قالب bar.
quizzes.why_answer_ar: a bar of chocolate تعبير ثابت.
quizzes.example_sentence_en: I bought a bar of chocolate.

quizzes.question_en: ........... money do you have?
quizzes.arabic_explanation: money غير معدود → How much.
quizzes.example_sentence_en: How much time do we have?

quizzes.question_en: She ........... at home yesterday.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: yesterday + فعل ماضٍ؛ she → was.
quizzes.example_sentence_en: He was tired yesterday.

quizzes.question_en: ........... apples are there in the basket?
quizzes.arabic_explanation: apples جمع معدود → How many.
quizzes.example_sentence_en: How many chairs do you see?

quizzes.question_en: There ........... many people at the concert last week.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: many people جمع؛ الماضي → were.
quizzes.example_sentence_en: There were many cars outside.

quizzes.question_en: ........... you at school last Monday?
quizzes.arabic_explanation: you مع were في الماضي؛ last Monday ماضٍ.
quizzes.grammar_rule_ar: Are للحاضر؛ Were للماضي مع you.
quizzes.example_sentence_en: Were they at home last night?

quizzes.question_en: They (not play) football yesterday.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: الماضي البسيط المنفي: didn't + مصدر base form.
quizzes.example_sentence_en: They didn't watch TV yesterday.

quizzes.question_en: She (watch) a movie last night.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: last night → watched ماضٍ بسيط.
quizzes.vocabulary: movie = فيلم | last night = الليلة الماضية
quizzes.example_sentence_en: She called me yesterday.

quizzes.question_en: What ........... you do last night?
quizzes.arabic_explanation: فعل معني في الماضي: What did you do?
quizzes.common_mistake_ar: What you do بدون did خطأ.
quizzes.example_sentence_en: What did he say?

quizzes.question_en: He ........... (go) to the supermarket yesterday morning.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: go → went في الماضي؛ شكل غير منتظم.
quizzes.example_sentence_en: She went home early.

quizzes.question_en: Lions are ........... than cats.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: المقارنة بين اثنين تستخدم comparative: more dangerous.
quizzes.grammar_rule_ar: the most لأكثر من اثنين عادة؛ more + than لاثنين.
quizzes.common_mistake_ar: استخدام superlative بدون أكثر من شيء في المقارنة.
quizzes.example_sentence_en: Elephants are bigger than dogs.

quizzes.question_en: This exercise is ........... than the last one.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: than يتطلب صيغة comparative: easier.
quizzes.example_sentence_en: This route is shorter than that one.

quizzes.question_en: They ........... lunch at the moment.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: at the moment = الآن → Present Continuous: are having.
quizzes.vocabulary: at the moment = في هذه اللحظة
quizzes.example_sentence_en: We are studying right now.

quizzes.question_en: My parents ........... two cars.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: parents جمع → have got.
quizzes.example_sentence_en: We have got a new apartment.

quizzes.question_en: This restaurant is ........... one in the area.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: في منطقة (مجموعة) نستخدم superlative: the most famous.
quizzes.common_mistake_ar: the more famous بدون than غير مكتمل هنا.
quizzes.example_sentence_en: It's the busiest day of the year.

quizzes.question_en: She usually ........... to school by bus.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: usually + Present Simple؛ she → goes.
quizzes.example_sentence_en: He walks to work every day.

quizzes.question_en: Listen! The baby ...........
quizzes.arabic_explanation: Listen! يشير لحدث الآن → is crying.
quizzes.example_sentence_en: Look! It's raining.

quizzes.question_en: We ........... in Los Angeles.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: we + فعل مصدر في الحاضر البسيط: live.
quizzes.example_sentence_en: They work in a bank.

quizzes.question_en: This is me with my sisters. I ........... five sisters.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: I → have got.
quizzes.example_sentence_en: I have got blue eyes.

quizzes.question_en: They are twins but they aren't identical. Khalid ........... brown eyes.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: Khalid مفرد → has got.
quizzes.common_mistake_ar: have got مع اسم مفرد خطأ.
quizzes.example_sentence_en: She has got long hair.

quizzes.arabic_explanation: نفي have got مع I: haven't got.
quizzes.why_answer_ar: not got بدون have غير معياري هنا.
quizzes.common_mistake_ar: have not a beard تركيب ضعيف مقارنة بـ haven't got.
quizzes.example_sentence_en: I haven't got any brothers.

quizzes.question_en: Sometimes I drive to the shops and sometimes I ........... the bus.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: I + Present Simple: take.
quizzes.example_sentence_en: I often take the train.

quizzes.question_en: The summer in Saudi Arabia is ........... Iceland.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: مقارنة بين مكانين تحتاج than بعد comparative.
quizzes.example_sentence_en: Riyadh is warmer than London.

quizzes.question_en: I go to work by bus. It's ........... than going by car because I can read a book.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: السياق إيجابي للحافلة: better than.
quizzes.example_sentence_en: Walking is healthier than driving.

quizzes.question_en: New Year is the ........... holiday in China.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: في الصين بين كل العطل → the most important.
quizzes.common_mistake_ar: more important بدون than في مجموعة ضمنية.
quizzes.example_sentence_en: This is the easiest question.

quizzes.question_en: We called a taxi ........... we were late for the meeting.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: السبب: because نحن تأخرنا.
quizzes.example_sentence_en: I stayed home because I was sick.

quizzes.question_en: I needed some money ........... I looked for a cash machine.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: الحاجة للمال نتيجة تبحث عن ماكينة: so للنتيجة.
quizzes.grammar_rule_ar: because لو عكس الترتيب المعنوي أحيانًا.
quizzes.common_mistake_ar: because هنا يجعل الترتيب أضعف منطقًا من so.
quizzes.example_sentence_en: It started raining, so we went inside.

quizzes.question_en: The company ........... any money at the moment.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: the company مفرد → isn't making.
quizzes.example_sentence_en: The shop isn't opening today.

quizzes.question_en: Ahmad is ........... from home this morning.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: is + verb-ing للحدث الجاري صباحًا.
quizzes.grammar_rule_ar: this morning قد يكون مستمرًا أو مخططًا حسب السياق.
quizzes.vocabulary: working from home = العمل عن بُعد من المنزل
quizzes.common_mistake_ar: works مع is خطأ مزدوج فعل.
quizzes.example_sentence_en: She is studying for her exam.

quizzes.question_en: Usually, she ........... to the park during the week.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: she + doesn't + مصدر في النفي المعتاد.
quizzes.example_sentence_en: He doesn't like coffee.

quizzes.question_en: I'm ........... to the cinema tonight.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: be going to / plan: I'm going to.
quizzes.common_mistake_ar: go مباشرة بعد I'm هنا غير مكتمل.
quizzes.example_sentence_en: I'm going to visit my aunt tomorrow.

quizzes.question_en: He has ........... his keys again.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: Present Perfect: has + past participle → lost.
quizzes.example_sentence_en: I have lost my wallet.

quizzes.question_en: We are going to ........... our teacher a gift.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: going to + مصدر: give.
quizzes.why_answer_ar: to + base verb بعد be going to.
quizzes.common_mistake_ar: giving بدون to صيغة خاطئة هنا.
quizzes.example_sentence_en: We are going to buy snacks.

quizzes.question_en: He looks tired. He ........... worked hard today.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: تعب ناتج عن عمل: has worked (experience/today).
quizzes.why_answer_ar: Present Perfect مع today ممكن للحدث في يوم لم ينتهِ.
quizzes.example_sentence_en: She has studied a lot this week.

quizzes.question_en: They have ........... their homework already.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: have + finished participle.
quizzes.example_sentence_en: We have finished the project.

quizzes.question_en: The milk ........... bitter.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: الطعم bitter → tastes.
quizzes.example_sentence_en: This soup tastes salty.

quizzes.question_en: My uncle is going to ........... a birthday present for Ahmed.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: going to + buy.
quizzes.example_sentence_en: I'm going to call you later.

quizzes.question_en: Have you ever ........... a horse?
quizzes.arabic_explanation: ever + Present Perfect: Have you ever ridden?
quizzes.example_sentence_en: Have you ever been to Paris?

quizzes.question_en: I went to Japan ........... learn Japanese.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: غرض: to + مصدر learn.
quizzes.common_mistake_ar: for learn أقل شيوعًا من to learn هنا.
quizzes.example_sentence_en: She came here to study medicine.

quizzes.question_en: This dress ........... beautiful.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: مظهر: looks beautiful.
quizzes.example_sentence_en: That idea sounds interesting.

quizzes.question_en: She has ........... her bag in the car.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: has left = تركت (نتيجة الآن).
quizzes.example_sentence_en: I've left my phone upstairs.

quizzes.question_en: I went to the park ........... play football.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: غرض الزيارة: to play.
quizzes.example_sentence_en: He came to help us.

quizzes.question_en: They ........... a lot of funny jokes.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: they + know في الحاضر.
quizzes.example_sentence_en: We know the answer.

quizzes.question_en: He's never ........... a famous person.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: He's never met = Present Perfect.
quizzes.example_sentence_en: I've never tried sushi before.

quizzes.question_en: I feel tired because I ........... for hours.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: for hours + Present Perfect: have worked.
quizzes.why_answer_ar: الاستمرار حتى الآن يؤثر على التعب.
quizzes.common_mistake_ar: worked بسيط قد يُقبل لكن have worked أدق مع for hours.
quizzes.example_sentence_en: She has lived here for ten years.

quizzes.question_en: It's going to ........... tomorrow.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: going to + rain مصدر.
quizzes.example_sentence_en: It's going to snow tonight.

quizzes.question_en: He made a cake ........... surprise his family.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: غرض: to surprise.
quizzes.common_mistake_ar: for surprise أقل دقة من to.
quizzes.example_sentence_en: She whispered to avoid waking the baby.

quizzes.question_en: I've never ........... sushi before.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: I've never eaten: Present Perfect.
quizzes.example_sentence_en: They've never visited us.

quizzes.question_en: We've ........... our car to the garage.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: We've taken: have + taken.
quizzes.example_sentence_en: She has taken the bus.

quizzes.question_en: They've ........... the room already.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: have cleaned participle.
quizzes.example_sentence_en: I've cleaned the kitchen.

quizzes.question_en: You ........... show your passport before you go through security.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: you + have to للالتزام قبل الأمن.
quizzes.why_answer_ar: has to لضمائر مفردة غير you.
quizzes.example_sentence_en: You have to wear a seat belt.

quizzes.question_en: You ........... take large bottles of liquid on the plane.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: قواعد السفر: لا يُنصح بزجاجات كبيرة؛ shouldn't.
quizzes.grammar_rule_ar: can/have to لا يطابق قاعدة السوائل عادة.
quizzes.example_sentence_en: You shouldn't run near the pool.

quizzes.question_en: You ........... bring your camera if you want; photography is optional.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: اختياري optional → don't have to.
quizzes.grammar_rule_ar: have to للإلزام؛ don't have to لعدمه.
quizzes.common_mistake_ar: should يقلل من حرية الاختيار المعنوية هنا.
quizzes.example_sentence_en: You don't have to pay; it's free.

quizzes.question_en: There's ........... to eat on the plane; please bring your own snack.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: اطلب وجبتك؛ لا يوجد أكل → nothing.
quizzes.common_mistake_ar: anywhere to eat تركيب أضعف للمعنى المطلوب.
quizzes.example_sentence_en: There was nothing to drink.

quizzes.question_en: I met ........... from Brazil on my last trip.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: شخص غير محدد في إيجابية: someone.
quizzes.common_mistake_ar: anyone في جملة إيجابية أقل شيوعًا هنا.
quizzes.example_sentence_en: Someone called while you were out.

quizzes.question_en: The Amazon River ........... through Brazil.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: the river مفرد → flows.
quizzes.example_sentence_en: The Nile runs through several countries.

quizzes.question_en: ........... Sahara Desert is in Africa.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: أسماء جغرافية فريدة: The Sahara.
quizzes.why_answer_ar: the مع صحارٍ وممالك بحرية محددة.
quizzes.example_sentence_en: The United Kingdom is in Europe.

quizzes.question_en: Temperatures ........... rise in the next 50 years due to climate change.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: توقع علمي: will rise.
quizzes.common_mistake_ar: won't rise يعكس نص التغير المتوقع.
quizzes.example_sentence_en: Prices will probably increase.

quizzes.question_en: When you visit famous places and enjoy the views, you are ...........
quizzes.arabic_explanation: زيارة معالم ومشاهد = sightseeing.
quizzes.example_sentence_en: We went sightseeing in Rome.

quizzes.question_en: Money used in a country is called ...........
quizzes.arabic_explanation: العملة الرسمية currency.
quizzes.example_sentence_en: You can exchange currency at the airport.

quizzes.question_en: The average temperature is 30 ...........
quizzes.arabic_explanation: درجة حرارة تقاس بـ degrees Celsius.
quizzes.example_sentence_en: It's 25 degrees outside.

quizzes.question_en: An astronomer is a person who ...........
quizzes.arabic_explanation: عالم فلك يدرس النجوم والكواكب.
quizzes.why_answer_ar: B أقرب لعالم الأرصاد؛ C عام جدًا.
quizzes.example_sentence_en: Astronomers use telescopes.

Before boarding, passengers have to show passports and tickets. You mustn't leave your luggage unattended. You can take one carry-on bag. Food and drink are available after security.

quizzes.question_en:
Read the text:
The Pacific Ocean is the largest in the world. The average depth is about 4,000 m. The Earth's surface is 70 % water. Scientists say the sea level will rise by 30 cm by 2100.

15. How deep is the Pacific Ocean on average?
quizzes.arabic_explanation: النص: average depth is about 4,000 m.
quizzes.common_mistake_ar: خلط عمق المحيط بارتفاع البحر 2100 أو 30 سم.
quizzes.example_sentence_en: The trench is extremely deep.

quizzes.question_en:
Read the text:
The Pacific Ocean is the largest in the world. The average depth is about 4,000 m. The Earth's surface is 70 % water. Scientists say the sea level will rise by 30 cm by 2100.

16. What do scientists predict?
options: C. The sea level will rise.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: النص: sea level will rise by 30 cm.
quizzes.vocabulary: sea level = مستوى سطح البحر | predict = يتنبأ
quizzes.example_sentence_en: Coastal cities may face flooding.

quizzes.question_en: I like to go ........... on the weekends.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: التخييم نشاط شائع مع go + مصدر في التعبير like to go camping.
quizzes.vocabulary: camping = تخييم | weekends = عطلة نهاية الأسبوع

quizzes.question_en: My friend Sara loves to ........... football twice a week.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: مع كرة القدم نستخدم الفعل play وليس go أو do في هذا السياق.

quizzes.question_en: A. Can you speak Italian? B. ...........
options: Yes, I can play the piano.
Yes, I can but not very well.
No, I can't but my friend can sing very well.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: الإجابة المباشرة عن القدرة على اللغة مع الإقرار بمستوى متوسط.
quizzes.why_answer_ar: تجيب عن السؤال بلغة إيطالية وليس بموهبة أخرى.
quizzes.grammar_rule_ar: إجابات can تكون متسقة مع السؤال.

quizzes.question_en: Choose the correct sentence:
options: Sara usually goes to the gym on the weekend.
Sara goes to the gym on the weekend usually.
Sara usually go to the gym on the weekend.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: المضارع البسيط مع الصف الثالث: goes؛ ظرف التكرار usually قبل الفعل الرئيسي غالبًا.
quizzes.grammar_rule_ar: usually + فعل مضارع / الصف الثالث بـ s.

quizzes.question_en: A turtle ........... fly, but a bird ...........
quizzes.arabic_explanation: السلحفاة لا تطير؛ الطائر يستطيع الطيران.

quizzes.question_en: She ........... books before going to sleep.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: مع she نستخدم likes؛ بعد like/love يمكن gerund reading.

quizzes.question_en: An ........... works in an office.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: المحاسب يعمل في مكتب؛ pilot طيار؛ sales assistant في المتجر غالبًا.

quizzes.question_en: She ........... to school by bus every day.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: she + المضارع البسيط + s للفعل go.

quizzes.question_en: Choose the sentence with the correct capitalization:
options: Mona took her son to see dr. saleh at andalusia hospital in Jeddah.
Mona took her son to see Dr. Saleh at Andalusia Hospital in Jeddah.
Mona took her son to see dr. Saleh at Andalusia hospital in jeddah.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: Dr. ولقب، أسماء مستشفيات وأماكن وجدة بحرف كبير.

quizzes.question_en: Choose the correct question:
quizzes.arabic_explanation: سؤال المضارع البسيط: When + does + فاعل + مصدر؟

quizzes.question_en: When I was a child, I loved going to the ........... to learn about art and history.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: المتحف مكان الفن والتاريخ؛ المكتبة للكتب؛ الحديقة عامة.

quizzes.question_en: Two teams play against each other in ...........
quizzes.arabic_explanation: كرة السلة لعب جماعي بين فريقين؛ الملاكمة والدراجات سياق مختلف.

quizzes.question_en: My mom and dad ........... watching TV, but my sister ........... listening to music.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: الوالدان جمع فعل love؛ الصيغة الثانية وفق مفتاح الاختبار.
quizzes.why_answer_ar: توافق الفاعل مع الفعل حسب المنهج المطلوب.

quizzes.question_en: My grandfather is a ........... He lives in a farm.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: من يعيش في مزرعة غالبًا مزارع.

quizzes.question_en: What time ........... you get up in the morning?
quizzes.arabic_explanation: مع you في المضارع نستخدم do وليس does.

quizzes.question_en: My brother ........... football on weekends. He only plays on Mondays.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: النفي مع he: doesn't / does not + مصدر.
quizzes.why_answer_ar: does not play = لا يلعب (في عطلة نهاية الأسبوع).

quizzes.question_en: Choose the sentence with the correct capitalization:
options: Abdullah graduated from king saud university in december, and he studied French.
Abdullah graduated from King Saud University in december, and he studied french.
Abdullah graduated from King Saud University in December, and he studied French.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: اسم الجامعة وشهر ديسمبر ولغة French بحروف كبيرة حيث يجب.

quizzes.question_en: ........... coffee in the morning.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: جملة تبدو وكأن الفاعل هو he/she — الفعل الثالث drinks.

quizzes.question_en: Ahmad ........... arrives to work on time. He is never late.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: ليس متأخرًا أبدًا = يصل دائمًا في الوقت.

quizzes.question_en: I ........... very fast. I am the fastest in my family.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: القدرة على السباحة بسرعة؛ can + مصدر بدون s.
quizzes.why_answer_ar: can swim صحيح؛ can swims خطأ.

quizzes.question_en:
Read the text:
The Patel family lives in Senegal. Mr. Patel is a teacher, and Mrs. Patel is a nurse. They have two children, Aria and Sam. Every day, they have breakfast together. Mr. Patel goes to work, and Mrs. Patel takes Aria and Sam to school. After school, the children play in the garden. On weekends, the family visits the park. They love spending time together.

1. How many children are in the family?
quizzes.arabic_explanation: النص يذكر أن لدى العائلة طفلين.
quizzes.grammar_rule_ar: اقرأ القطعة وحدد الإجابة التي يدعمها النص صراحةً.

quizzes.arabic_explanation: النص: «On weekends, the family visits the park».
quizzes.why_answer_ar: الزيارة في عطلة نهاية الأسبوع وليس كل يوم.
quizzes.grammar_rule_ar: اقرأ القطعة وحدد الإجابة التي يدعمها النص صراحةً.

quizzes.question_en:
Read the text:
In the U.K, there is a man named Mr. Davis. He loves old furniture. Every weekend, he looks for old chairs, tables, and cabinets. Mr. Davis cleans the furniture and fixes it. Some pieces are very old, but he makes them look new again. He has many old chairs and tables in his house. People in the town know him well. Sometimes, they give him old furniture, and he is always happy to take it.

1. What does Mr. Davis do on the weekends?
quizzes.arabic_explanation: في عطلة الأسبوع يبحث عن أثاث قديم ويجمعه.
quizzes.why_answer_ar: «looks for old chairs, tables, and cabinets» يعادل جمع/استقطاب الأثاث.
quizzes.grammar_rule_ar: اقرأ القطعة وحدد الإجابة التي يدعمها النص صراحةً.

quizzes.question_en:
Read the text:
In the U.K, there is a man named Mr. Davis. He loves old furniture. Every weekend, he looks for old chairs, tables, and cabinets. Mr. Davis cleans the furniture and fixes it. Some pieces are very old, but he makes them look new again. He has many old chairs and tables in his house. People in the town know him well. Sometimes, they give him old furniture, and he is always happy to take it.

2. The passage is mainly about?
quizzes.arabic_explanation: القطعة تركز على الأثاث القديم وجمعه وليس وصف المدينة.
quizzes.why_answer_ar: الموضوع هو امتلاك الأثاث وجمعه وليس المدينة.
quizzes.grammar_rule_ar: اقرأ القطعة وحدد الإجابة التي يدعمها النص صراحةً.

quizzes.question_en:
Read the text:
In their free time, people like to do many fun activities. Some people read books or watch movies. Others enjoy playing sports like soccer or basketball. Many people like to go for walks in the park or ride bikes. Some enjoy cooking or baking delicious food. Friends often meet to chat and have fun together. Some people like to listen to music or play musical instruments. Others may enjoy painting or drawing. Many people also play video games or spend time on the internet. Everyone has different hobbies, and that makes free time special.

1. In their free time, students like to play video games?
quizzes.arabic_explanation: النص يذكر أن كثيرين من الناس يلعبون ألعاب فيديو؛ الطلاب ضمن الناس العاديين في هذا السياق التعليمي.
quizzes.why_answer_ar: «Many people also play video games» يدعم صحة الفكرة.
quizzes.grammar_rule_ar: اقرأ القطعة وحدد الإجابة التي يدعمها النص صراحةً.

quizzes.grammar_rule_ar: اقرأ القطعة وحدد الإجابة التي يدعمها النص صراحةً.

quizzes.question_en:
Read the text:
People work in many places. For example, some work in offices. When they work there, they use computers and write emails to send information. Other people work in schools as teachers. They teach students. Some work in hospitals and help sick people. There are also workers in restaurants. They cook food and serve customers. Factories are also places of work where people make products like toys and cars. Each place of work is important!

1. Which of the following sentences is correct about emails?
options: People do not usually use them at work.
They are a useless communication tool.
They are used to send information.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: في المكتب يُستخدم الحاسوب والبريد لإرسال المعلومات.
quizzes.why_answer_ar: النص يذكر «write emails to send information».
quizzes.grammar_rule_ar: اقرأ القطعة وحدد الإجابة التي يدعمها النص صراحةً.

quizzes.grammar_rule_ar: اقرأ القطعة وحدد الإجابة التي يدعمها النص صراحةً.

quizzes.question_en:
Read the text:
When you go to the supermarket, it's important to understand food labels. The cost tells you how much money you need to pay. Check the 'best before' date to know when the food is still good to eat. Look for the amount of fat on the label—some fat is healthy, but too much is not good for you. Natural foods come from plants or animals and have fewer chemicals, while superfoods are especially nutritious, like blueberries and spinach.

1. What does the "best before" date on a food label indicate?
options: When the food is still good to eat.
How much fat is in the food.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: النص يشرح أن التاريخ يبيّن متى يظل الطعام صالحًا.
quizzes.why_answer_ar: يطابق عبارة «when the food is still good to eat».
quizzes.grammar_rule_ar: اقرأ القطعة وحدد الإجابة التي يدعمها النص صراحةً.

quizzes.grammar_rule_ar: اقرأ القطعة وحدد الإجابة التي يدعمها النص صراحةً.

quizzes.question_en: My sister's daughter is my...
quizzes.arabic_explanation: ابنة الأخت هي niece بالإنجليزية.
quizzes.example_sentence_en: My niece is five years old.

quizzes.question_en: Toyota is a ... company.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: نحتاج صفًا يصف الشركة: يابانية Japanese.
quizzes.grammar_rule_ar: الصفات الوطنية بصيغة صفة قبل الاسم.

quizzes.question_en: Ahmed: Where ... you from?
quizzes.arabic_explanation: مع الضمير you يُستخدم فعل are.
quizzes.why_answer_ar: Where are you from? تعبير ثابت.

quizzes.question_en: My daughter's son is my...
quizzes.arabic_explanation: ابن الابنة هو حفيد grandson.

quizzes.question_en: I ... to school every day at 7:30 am.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: المضارع البسيط مع I والعادة اليومية.

quizzes.question_en: I travelled to Al-Lith last week. The weather ... great.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: حدث في الماضي؛ الجو مفرد فيستخدم was.

quizzes.question_en: How ... money do you have?
quizzes.arabic_explanation: مع الاسم غير المعدود money نستخدم much في السؤال.

quizzes.question_en: ... are large pieces of cloth that hang across a window to stop light.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: الستائر curtains تُعلق على النوافذ.

quizzes.question_en: In Jeddah, there is a ... which has more than 10,000 books.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: مكان يضم آلاف الكتب هو المكتبة.

quizzes.question_en: What is the meaning of the word "identical"?
quizzes.arabic_explanation: Identical تعني متطابقة تمامًا.

quizzes.question_en: Muslims around the world ... during the daytime in Ramadan.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: جمع Muslims يتطلب don't وليس doesn't.

quizzes.question_en: The summer in Saudi Arabia is ... in Iceland.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: المقارنة بين بلدين تتطلب than.

quizzes.question_en: Lions are ... than cats.
quizzes.arabic_explanation: than يدل على مقارنة؛ نستخدم more dangerous.

quizzes.question_en: Money used in a country is called ...
quizzes.arabic_explanation: العملة الرسمية currency.

grammar-be-am-is-are.title_ar: الفعل be: am و is و are
grammar-be-am-is-are.explanation_ar: الفعل be يربط الفاعل بالخبر (اسم أو صفة). مع I نستخدم am، مع he و she و it نستخدم is، مع you و we و they نستخدم are. للسؤال نقدّم الفعل: Am I…؟ Are you…؟ Is he…؟ وللنفي نضيف not أو نستخدم الصيغ المختصرة isn't و aren't.
grammar-be-am-is-are.rule_en: Affirmative: I am / I'm; you/we/they are / you're/we're/they're; he/she/it is / he's/she's/it's. Negative: … am/is/are not or isn't/aren't (not with I → I'm not). Questions: Am / Are / Is + subject + …?

rows: You are not · You aren't · You're not
He is not · He isn't · He's not
She is not · She isn't · She's not
It is not · It isn't · It's not
We are not · We aren't · We're not
They are not · They aren't · They're not

grammar-be-am-is-are.notes_ar: مصدر الشريحة التعليمية: SWET24 — Grammar be (am/is/are). مع I لا نقول *I isn't*؛ النفي الصحيح I'm not. انتبه: it's قد تعني it is أو it has حسب السياق، وليست ضمير ملكية.
grammar-be-am-is-are.mistakes_ar: خطأ شائع: استخدام is مع they أو we. آخر: خلط its (ملكية) مع it's (اختصار).
grammar-be-am-is-are.compare_ar: أفعال أخرى في المضارع تستخدم do/does للسؤال والنفي؛ be وحده له أشكال am/is/are.

quiz.rule_ar: Verb be: third person singular → is.

quiz.why_ar: أسئلة be مع you تبدأ بـ Are.
سؤال بحالة أو هوية لشخص → Is he…?
milk غير معدود في هذا النمط الشائع → Is there…?
you دائمًا مع are في اللغة المعيارية.
مع I في السؤال يبدأ بـ Am.
Mathematics اسم مادة يُعامل كمفرد → is.

quiz.question_en: ___ we allowed to use phones here?
They ___ not interested in the offer.

present-simple.explanation_ar: المضارع البسيط يصف العادات والحقائق والروتين. مع he/she/it نضيف s أو es للفعل. النفي: don't أو doesn't + مصدر الفعل. السؤال: Do أو Does + الفاعل + مصدر الفعل؟
present-simple.rule_en: Affirmative: Subject + verb (+ s/es for he/she/it). Negative: subject + do/does + not + base verb. Question: Do/Does + subject + base verb?

examples.en: Romie does not love to eat burgers.
Does Romie love to eat burgers?

present-simple.notes_ar: لا تضف s إذا سبق الفعل do/does في السؤال أو النفي (Does she play…?) الفعل يبقى مصدرًا.
present-simple.mistakes_ar: She work بدل She works. أو استخدام is مع فعل معنوي (*is plays).
present-simple.compare_ar: be له قواعده؛ الأفعال الأخرى تستخدم do/does.

quiz.why_ar: they جمع بدون s على الفعل.
Does مع الصف الثالث للسؤال عن فعل معنوي.
حقيقة عامة؛ the sun مفرد → rises.
you مع Do في الأسئلة للأفعال المعنوية.

quiz.question_en: She ___ not watch TV at night.

quiz.why_ar: Does مع it للفعل المعنوي rain.

possessive-adjectives-s.explanation_ar: الصفات الملكية تسبق الاسم وتُظهر الملكية: my، your، his، her، its، our، their. لا تأخذ فصلًا مثل الضمائر المنفصلة. ملحق الملكية ’s يُضاف غالبًا للأشخاص أو الكائنات التي «تمتلك» شيئًا: Ahmed's phone.
possessive-adjectives-s.rule_en: Possessive adjectives (determiners): my book, your idea, his car, her job, its tail, our house, their friends. Possessive ’s: noun + ’s + noun (often people / animals).
possessive-adjectives-s.notes_ar: صيغة 1: ضمير فاعل + فعل (I am a teacher). صيغة 2: صفة ملكية + اسم (These are my shoes). its بلا فتحة = ملكية؛ it's = it is أو it has. their للجمع؛ they're = they are.
possessive-adjectives-s.mistakes_ar: كتابة hes بدل his؛ أو استخدام her مع ذكر الجنس بالخطأ.
possessive-adjectives-s.compare_ar: Possessive pronouns (mine, yours…) تأتي بدون اسم بعدها؛ الصفات الملكية يجب أن يتبعها اسم.

quiz.question_en: Anna forgot ___ keys on the bus.
quiz.why_ar: اسم شيء بعد الصفة الملكية → her.

quiz.question_en: Is this ___ pen? — Yes, it's mine.
___ bag is heavier: yours or mine?
Those seats are ___. (they belong to us)
quiz.why_ar: ضمير ملكية منفصل بدون اسم بعده.

quiz.question_en: She spoke to ___ teacher after class.
___ not my coat — pick the contraction for «it is».

coordinating-conjunctions-and-or-but.title_ar: أدوات الربط: and و or و but
coordinating-conjunctions-and-or-but.explanation_ar: أدوات الربط المتساوية تربط كلمات أو مجموعات كلمات من نفس النوع. and تربط أفكارًا متشابهة أو إضافية؛ or تربط بدائل؛ but تربط تباينًا أو تعارضًا بين جزأين.
coordinating-conjunctions-and-or-but.rule_en: and → similar / added ideas; or → alternatives (choice); but → contrast.

rows: Do you want an apple or a banana?
I like apples but I don't like bananas.

examples.en: Do you want tea or coffee?

coordinating-conjunctions-and-or-but.notes_ar: الأجزاء المتصلة يجب أن تكون متوازية نحويًا (اسم واسم، جملة وجملة…).
coordinating-conjunctions-and-or-but.mistakes_ar: استخدام but رغم عدم وجود تعارض؛ أو but بين عناصر غير متوازية.
coordinating-conjunctions-and-or-but.compare_ar: because تشرح السبب؛ but تعرض التباين فقط.

quiz.question_en: I bought bread ___ butter at the store.
quiz.why_ar: إضافة غرضين متشابهين في القائمة → and.

quiz.question_en: Do you want the red one ___ the blue one?
She wanted to stay, ___ she had to leave.
Walk straight ___ turn left at the bank.
She likes maths ___ finds physics difficult.
Do you travel by bus ___ by train?
I'd love to go, ___ I'm too busy.

there-is-there-are.explanation_ar: نستخدم There is / There are لقول أن شيئًا موجودًا (أو غير موجود) في مكان أو سياق. الشكل يتبع أول اسم بعد there غالبًا: مفرد أو غير معدود → there is؛ جمع → there are. مع الجمل غير المعدودة مثل milk نستخدم there is some milk.
there-is-there-are.rule_en: There is + singular / uncountable. There are + plural nouns. Negative: There isn't / There aren't. Question: Is there…? Are there…?

rows: There is a book on the desk.
There are books on the desk.
There is some milk in the fridge.

examples.en: There is a book on the desk.
There are books on the desk.
There is some milk in the fridge.

there-is-there-are.notes_ar: في اللغة المنطوقة يُسمع There's مع جمع أحيانًا؛ في الامتحانات الرسمية التزم there are مع الجمع.
there-is-there-are.mistakes_ar: There is مع جمع (*There is many books).
there-is-there-are.compare_ar: They are يصف «هم»؛ there are يصف وجود أشياء في مكان.

quiz.question_en: There ___ two pens on the floor.
There ___ a problem with the Wi‑Fi.

quiz.why_ar: sugar غير معدود هنا → Is there…?

quiz.question_en: There ___ some chairs in the room.
There ___ a cat and two dogs in the yard.
quiz.why_ar: الاتفاق غالبًا مع أول اسم (a cat) في اللغة غير الرسمية؛ المعيار التعليمي يركز there is مع أول عنصر مفرد.
quiz.rule_ar: There is + first item singular (proximity agreement).

prepositions-of-place.explanation_ar: حروف الجر التي تلي اسم مكان توضح موضع الشيء بالنسبة لآخر: داخل (in)، على سطح (on)، تحت (under)، أمام (in front of)، خلف (behind)، بجانب (next to)، فوق (above)، أسفل (below)، بين (between)، يمين/يسار، مقابل (opposite).
prepositions-of-place.rule_en: in / on / under / in front of / behind / next to / above / below / between / on the left / on the right / opposite + noun phrase.

rows: The keys are in the drawer.
The phone is on the table.
The cat is under the chair.
There is a tree in front of the house.
The cafe is between the bank and the library.
The flat above ours is noisy.
The hospital is opposite the park.

examples.en: Your bag is under the seat.
The picture hangs above the sofa.
She waited at the bus stop opposite the school.
examples.ar: انتظرت عند موقف الحافلة مقابل المدرسة.

prepositions-of-place.notes_ar: أحيانًا يختلف الإنجليزي عن العربية: in the street قد تكون on في الأمريكية — ركّز على ما في المنهج.
prepositions-of-place.mistakes_ar: خلط on و in (على الطاولة on؛ في الصندوق in).
prepositions-of-place.compare_ar: next to قريب جدًا؛ near أوسع؛ between يحتاج شيئين على الأقل.

quiz.question_en: The bank is ___ the post office and the cafe.
He stood ___ me in the queue.

quiz.why_ar: حركة إلى فوق السطح → onto (في هذا السياق التعليمي).

quiz.question_en: Sign your name ___ the dotted line.

plural-nouns.explanation_ar: جمع الاسم المنتظم غالبًا بإضافة s؛ بعد s, ch, sh, x, z نستخدم es؛ يـاء متحركة + y نحذف y ونضيف ies؛ حرف ساكن + o غالبًا es؛ استثناءات كثيرة للأفعال الشاذة والأسماء التي لا تتغير.
plural-nouns.rule_en: Regular +s; +es after s/ch/sh/x/z; consonant+y → ies; f/fe → often ves (roof/cliff exceptions); irregular: men, children, feet, mice, etc.; same form: sheep, deer, fish.

rows: man → men, child → children, foot → feet

plural-nouns.notes_ar: quiz → quizzes بحرفين zz + es. piano و photo غالبًا فقط s.
plural-nouns.mistakes_ar: potatos بدل potatoes؛ یا citys بدل cities.
plural-nouns.compare_ar: صفات المقارنة ليست جمع أسماء؛ لا تخلط -er مع جمع الجملة.

demonstratives-this-that-these-those.title_ar: This و that و these و those
demonstratives-this-that-these-those.explanation_ar: this و that لمفرد؛ these و those لجمع. غالبًا this/these للقرب الزماني أو المكاني؛ that/those للبعد. تُستخدم قبل اسم أو تشير لوحدها حسب السياق.
demonstratives-this-that-these-those.rule_en: This/that + singular noun. These/those + plural noun. This/these → nearer; that/those → farther.
demonstratives-this-that-these-those.notes_ar: هذه الأدوات تعمل كصفات تشيرية قبل الاسم؛ لا تخلط this مع جمع.
demonstratives-this-that-these-those.mistakes_ar: these apple بدل these apples؛ أو those مع مفرد.
demonstratives-this-that-these-those.compare_ar: أدوات الإشارة مختلفة عن he/she/it التي للضمير فقط.

quiz.question_en: ___ shoes here are mine; ___ ones over there are yours.
quiz.why_ar: أحذية جمع قريبة وبعيدة → these / those.

quiz.question_en: Look at ___ bird in the tree!
___ students in the back row, please stand.
___ was a great concert we saw last year.
quiz.why_ar: حديث عن تجربة في الماضي البعيد نسبيًا → That.

quiz.question_en: Are ___ your keys on the table?
Give me ___ book on the shelf (you point).
quiz.why_ar: كتاب واحد تُشير إليه بعيدًا → that.

capital-letters.explanation_ar: نبدأ الجملة بحرف كبير دائمًا. الأسماء الخاصة (أشخاص، مدن، بلدان)، أيام الأسبوع والشهور، الجنسيات واللغات كصفات، أسماء المؤسسات، وعناوين الكتب والأفلام تُكتب بحسب قواعد الأحرف الكبيرة في الإنجليزية.
capital-letters.rule_en: Capitalize: sentence beginnings; names and titles (Mr./Ms./Dr.); days and months; places; nationalities and languages; companies; book and film titles (major words).

examples.en: english is fun → English is fun.
i study on monday. → I study on Monday.
She lives in riyadh. → She lives in Riyadh.

capital-letters.notes_ar: في الواجبات والامتحان اتبع القواعد المعيارية وليس أسلوب الشات.
capital-letters.mistakes_ar: أيام الأسبوع بحروف صغيرة؛ أو french بدل French.
capital-letters.compare_ar: the بحرف صغير؛ الأسماء الخاصة بحرف كبير.

quiz.why_ar: بداية الجملة واسم اللغة بحرف كبير.
أيام الأسبوع بحرف كبير في الكتابة الرسمية.

like-love-noun-ing.title_ar: Like و Love مع اسم أو -ing
like-love-noun-ing.explanation_ar: بعد like و love و enjoy و hate يمكن أن يأتي اسم الشيء أو الفعل بصيغة -ing. مع he/she/it نضيف s للفعل like (likes).
like-love-noun-ing.rule_en: you/we/they + like/don't like + noun or -ing; he/she/it + likes/doesn't like + noun or -ing.
like-love-noun-ing.compare_ar: I like to dance مقبول أيضًا؛ الشرائح تركز على like + ing.

adverbs-of-frequency.explanation_ar: always، usually، often، sometimes، hardly ever، never توضّح التكرار. غالبًا قبل الفعل المعنوي الرئيسي، وبعد الفعل be.
adverbs-of-frequency.rule_en: Place before main verb; after be: She is always kind.

examples.en: I always brush my teeth before bed.

adverbs-of-frequency.notes_ar: He is usually tired — التكرار بعد be.
adverbs-of-frequency.mistakes_ar: *plays often tennis* خطأ؛ الصحيح often plays.

quiz.question_en: I ___ go to bed before 10 pm.
I ___ see snow — once a year.

can-cant-ability.explanation_ar: can تعبّر عن القدرة أو الإمكان؛ can't (cannot) عن عدم القدرة أو المنع حسب السياق. لا تصرف can مع الأشخاص (لا cans).
can-cant-ability.rule_en: can + base verb for ability: I can swim. She can't drive. Questions: Can you …?
can-cant-ability.notes_ar: can't = cannot؛ التقليل الرسمي cannot في النصوص الرسمية أحيانًا.
can-cant-ability.mistakes_ar: can to swim خطأ؛ المصدر مباشرة بعد can.

quiz.question_en: He ___ lift this box; it's too heavy.
My grandma ___ use a smartphone easily.

countable-uncountable-some-any.title_en: Countable vs uncountable — a / an / some / any
countable-uncountable-some-any.title_ar: المعدود وغير المعدود — a و an و some و any
countable-uncountable-some-any.explanation_ar: المعدود يُعدّ واحدًا واثنين… ويأتي مع a/an للمفرد، وبعض/عدة مع some في الإيجاب. غير المعدود (ماء، أرز…) لا يأتي مع a في المعنى العام؛ نستخدم some في الإيجاب وany غالبًا في النفي والأسئلة.
countable-uncountable-some-any.rule_en: a/an + singular countable; some + plural countable OR uncountable (positive); any often in negatives and questions.
countable-uncountable-some-any.notes_ar: an قبل صوت علة: an hour, an apple.
countable-uncountable-some-any.mistakes_ar: much apples خطأ؛ many للجمع المعدود.
countable-uncountable-some-any.compare_ar: some في العروض قد تُستخدم في أسئلة مهذبة: Would you like some tea?

quiz.question_en: We need ___ chairs for the party.

quiz.why_ar: سؤال عام عن وجود → any شائع.
الماء غير معدود في المعنى العام.
oranges جمع معدود→ How many لاحقًا؛ هنا many ضمن الخيارات للتمييز عن much.

a-lot-much-many.title_ar: A lot of و Much و Many
a-lot-much-many.explanation_ar: many مع الجمع المعدود؛ much مع الأسماء غير المعدودة في الأسئلة والنفي غالبًا؛ a lot of / lots of تعمل مع المعدود وغير المعدود في الإيجاب.
a-lot-much-many.rule_en: many + plural countable; much + uncountable (often questions/negatives); a lot of + plural OR uncountable.

examples.en: She eats a lot of fruit.

a-lot-much-many.notes_ar: very much للتأكيد مع الفعل أحيانًا؛ لا تخلطها مع many.
a-lot-much-many.compare_ar: a lot of أكثر حيادية في الإيجاب من much.

quiz.question_en: There isn't ___ water in the bottle.
We need ___ sugar for the cake.
There are ___ books on the shelf.

how-much-how-many.explanation_ar: How many للأسماء المعدودة الجمع؛ How much للأسماء غير المعدودة أو للسؤال عن السعر أحيانًا — بعض العروض تكتب «اسم مفرد»؛ المعيار النحوي هنا: الكمّ غير المعدود.
how-much-how-many.rule_en: How many + plural noun? How much + uncountable noun?

examples.en: How many pens do you have?

how-much-how-many.notes_ar: How much يمكن أن يعني السعر: How much is this?
how-much-how-many.compare_ar: How long للمدة؛ How often للتكرار.

was-were-past-be.title_ar: Was و Were — الماضي للفعل be
was-were-past-be.explanation_ar: الماضي من am/is هو was؛ الماضي من are هو were. نستخدمهما لوصف الأشخاص أو الأماكن أو الأوقات في الماضي.
was-were-past-be.rule_en: I/he/she/it was; you/we/they were. Questions: Was I…? Were you…? Negative: was not / wasn't; were not / weren't.
was-were-past-be.mistakes_ar: I were أو they was خطأ.
was-were-past-be.compare_ar: الماضي للأفعال الأخرى قد يكون went، played…؛ be له was/were.

quiz.question_en: There ___ three cats in the garden.

past-simple-regular-verbs.explanation_ar: الأفعال المنتظمَة تأخذ ed في الماضي (lived, watched, wanted). النفي: didn't + مصدر الفعل وليس الشكل الماضي. السؤال: Did + الفاعل + مصدر؟ الفعل الرئيسي يبقى مصدرًا لأن Did يحمل زمن الماضي.
past-simple-regular-verbs.rule_en: Affirmative: subject + verb-ed. Negative: subject + didn't + base verb. Question: Did + subject + base verb? Exception: verb be uses was/were, not did.
past-simple-regular-verbs.notes_ar: بعد didn't و Did لا تضع الفعل في صيغة الماضي (*didn't lived خطأ).

present-continuous-tense.explanation_ar: المضارع المستمر يصف حدثًا جاريًا الآن أو حول هذا الوقت، أو خططًا قريبة. التركيب: am / is / are + الفعل مع ing. النفي: am/is/are + not + ing. السؤال: Am/Is/Are + الفاعل + ing؟
present-continuous-tense.rule_en: Subject + am/is/are + verb-ing. Negative: am/is/are + not + verb-ing. Question: Am/Is/Are + subject + verb-ing?

rows: You are dancing on the stage.

be-going-to-future-plans.title_ar: Be going to للخطط والمستقبل القريب
be-going-to-future-plans.explanation_ar: نستخدم be going to للحديث عن خطط أو نوايا أو تنبؤات واضحة. التركيب: ضمير + am/is/are + going to + مصدر الفعل. النفي: am/is/are + not + going to + مصدر. السؤال: هل نقلب am/are/is مع الفاعل؟ نعم — Am I going to…؟ هل الإجابات القصيرة نعم/لا مع be كما في الشرائح.
be-going-to-future-plans.rule_en: Affirmative: subject + am/is/are + going to + base verb. Negative: … + am/is/are + not + going to + base. Questions: Am/Are/Is + subject + going to + base? Short answers: Yes, I am. / No, I'm not. WH-questions: Where are you going to stay?

infinitive-of-purpose.explanation_ar: نستخدم to + مصدر لشرح غرض الفعل السابق؛ معناها قريب من in order to. النفي في جملة المصدر: not to (مثل not to see her). يمكن أن يبدأ الجملة بـ To… للتركيز على الغرض.
infinitive-of-purpose.rule_en: Action + to + base verb (purpose). Negative purpose: … not to + verb. Sentence-initial: To get a passport, you should …

rows: She studied hard to pass the exams.
He sat elsewhere not to see her.
To learn English, she moved to London.

present-perfect-tense.rule_en: Subject + have/has + past participle. Negative: have/has + not + V3. Question: Have/Has + subject + V3?

past-simple-vs-present-perfect.rule_en: Past simple: definite finished time. Present perfect: connection to now, experience, unfinished time period.

rows: We lived in Japan from 1995 to 1998.
She has watched this movie three times.

rows: You have to wear a uniform.
You don't have to come on Sundays.
